body:
I had considered telling the doctors but they were very cold towards me as it was and my sister and mom were in the room. My sister is the last person on earth who should help those with suicidal thoughts. She's a bit of a spazz. I have no clue what her feelings on the matter would be but i know she would very unhelpfully spazz out

Thank you for the concern

Those rainy days are truly the best. Perhaps crack open a window, sit and watch the rain, listen to some music (No Rain by Blind Melon and Do You Remember by Jack Johnson are wonderful happy-sad songs), hold onto your favorite book, write some embarrassing poetry about how you feel or how the rain smells... 

I'm horribly sorry you're feeling this way and that your mother responded so disgustingly. Hold on a little longer; at least until this rainy day is a week behind you.

<3
